nodes.label: Figure 1 — spectral comparison
nodes.rationale: Caption must state that the two panels sit on different flux references — panel (a) uses Sim/OmniFluxes.tsv with R_gen=118cm, panel (b) uses Sim/S1GDMLSRON/OmniFluxes_Run1.tsv with the Building radius and its scale factors — the y-axes are not comparable between panels.

nodes.label: DM1.2 iso rerun (vs. focused macro)
nodes.rationale: The DM1.2 muon macro had previously used /gps/ang/type focused ten times, aiming every muon at the origin (median cos 0.994 to the origin, 56.8% inside cos>0.99); absolute rates from that configuration were never physical. All DM1.2 results in this document are from the iso (isotropic) rerun instead.

nodes.label: Efficiency factor (epsilon)
nodes.rationale: epsilon = (N_counts/N_shot)^MAGI / (N_counts/N_shot)^ref, R = epsilon x chi; retained only for continuity with earlier analysis. A perfect surrogate returns epsilon = 1/chi, not 1.

nodes.label: The 22x gap — superseded explanation
nodes.rationale: Previously attributed to the CR/40K runs not sharing a 40K source volume (a 57x ratio between a 2000x2000x400mm box and a 750x750x50mm box). That attribution is now known to be incomplete and its direction was wrong: the user confirmed the slab was the reduced one and the model unshielded, so both runs sample the same physical volume and the 57x factor never applied as stated. The dominant, corrected cause is the albedo-selection bug instead; the conclusion (MAGI sits with the population it was trained on) still stands, but for a different and larger reason.

nodes.label: CryoSphere/PlateCu1 overlap bug (39% crossing loss)
nodes.rationale: At R=105mm the CryoSphere intersected PlateCu1 (a 150mm-radius, 5mm-thick copper disc) by at least 1.29mm with overlap checking disabled; Geant4 navigation inside an overlap is undefined and 39.4% of detector events had no recorded crossing, uniform 58-63% across five runs, 93.5% of them primary-muon deposits. Moving the sphere to R=95mm restores 100.0% coverage; the SRON sphere was checked and is clean.

nodes.label: Inconsistent ingoing-particle cut
nodes.rationale: EventAction.cc skips outgoing crossings at registration, but the SRON training sets predate that code (CR set contains 10.37% outgoing crossings, 40K set 22.53%, DM1.2 set 0.00%). MAGI applies no ingoing/outgoing selection and generates 13.59% outgoing against the CR training set's 10.37%, accounting for 3.6% of the SRON rate deficit. This also means the SRON and DM1.2 models are on different conventions.

nodes.label: NgenPotassiumForMAGI_v082 bookkeeping correction
nodes.rationale: Declared as 580,000,000 but measured from the run's own output as 538,205,667 (7.8% high, outside the 95% region of both jobs' order statistics), caused by the output file concatenating two jobs with exactly one backward EventId jump at row 398,400. Every v0.8.2 40K flux and efficiency number rises by a correction factor of 1.0777 (e.g. Detector-1 efficiency 3472→3741); the detector-level closure result above is unaffected because it never uses this constant.

nodes.label: Normalization-free comparison (R metric)
nodes.rationale: R = (N_events/N_crossings)^MAGI / (N_events/N_crossings)^real is used for every headline number because it requires no exposure, detector area, flux normalization, or crossing efficiency chi, making it insensitive to every quantity that has historically caused discordance between MAGI-side and Geant4-side bookkeeping.

nodes.label: Provenance tag system (Table 4)
nodes.rationale: Every numeric claim in the document carries a provenance tag [Ex] resolving to Table 4; tags point at files and runs on the local machine, not literature citations — this exists so numbers entering the proceeding and flash talk can be traced to the run that produced them. Superseded and withdrawn results are retained and marked, not deleted.

nodes.label: SphereCenter 2500mm error (EventAction.cc:237)
nodes.rationale: EventAction.cc:237 carries SphereCenter(0.,0.,-3007.6*mm), a 2500mm error versus the true centre of -507.66mm. 100.00% of recorded crossings are ingoing w.r.t. the wrong centre (97.28% moving downward) versus 77.45% ingoing w.r.t. the true centre — 40K gammas travelling up from the floor were being selected as if a cut toward a centre 2500mm below kept only photons that scattered off the structure above and came back.

nodes.label: 40K training population is albedo, not the crossing population
nodes.norm_label: 40k training population is albedo, not the crossing population
nodes.rationale: The spectrum confirms the SphereCenter bug independently: median deposited energy is 211.2 keV against the Compton 180° backscatter energy of the 1460.8 keV line (217.5 keV); 30.4% of crossings lie within ±15% of it; the 1461 keV line appears only once in 1.87M events (an unscattered line photon cannot be moving downward at the sphere). Ra-226 and Th-232 are affected identically. The detector-level closure numbers survive unchanged as a self-consistency check but must NOT be restated as a physics claim about real 40K background.
